answers.how: The cleaner moves about 159 pixels in 1 second, giving 159 pixels per meter. The sofa spans about 497 pixels: 497/159 ≈ 3.13.
Using 159 pixels per meter from the cleaner's motion, the TV's approximately 323-pixel length is 323/159 ≈ 2.03.
The cleaner's diameter is about 57 pixels. Its motion gives 159 pixels per meter, so 57/159 ≈ 0.36.
The chessboard side measures about 67 pixels. Using 159 pixels per meter gives 67/159 ≈ 0.42.
The tray side measures about 51 pixels. Using 159 pixels per meter gives 51/159 ≈ 0.32.
